description: Search for PEOPLE (potential leads) matching filters such as job title, seniority, company, CNPJ, industry, location or a buyingSignal (hiring, funding, news, job_change, tech, cnpj, crm, visitor, any). Company discover uses the enabled signal sources. job_change is company hire/promote/leave news when those domains exist; otherwise it searches person movers in the last 90 days through enabled sources. A campaign job_change gate also lets a fresh person move through. tech needs technologies[] (job-post evidence first, then site technology detection); cnpj uses the Brazilian registry; crm uses closed-lost deals and champions who left in the connected HubSpot or Salesforce; visitor uses identified visits already on inbound sheets. People are then searched at those companies. Returns a list of candidate people with name, headline, company and (when available) email and LinkedIn URL, for building a prospect list from criteria. Metered per delivered result: each search spends credits. In-product Agent searches automatically make one provider-fallback attempt when the first cascade returns fewer rows than requested. Searches shown as tables are quality-reviewed and may also replace rejected rows through another provider. page pages through results with the same filters; an empty page means there are no more, and pages may overlap. Every result carries funnel (requested, found, kept, removed by reason: same_company, outside_sector, registry_mismatch, customer and others) and funnelText, one plain sentence of it. Lists across companies keep one person per company unless peoplePerCompany is set. A CNAE or another Receita filter is exact only on rows with a CNPJ: on rows without one a CNAE is approximated by the company's industry (filterReport.registry counts each way). Near misses (sector not confirmed) are counted in nearMisses, held back and not charged; with includeNearMisses they come after the full matches, each marked nearMiss. limit goes up to 200: the search reads page after page of the sources until it has that many or they run dry (funnel.stoppedBy says which). When the most it can cost is above the larger of 50 credits and 20% of the balance, it searches nothing and returns status quote (people, maxCredits, balance, quoteText); the same call with confirmed true runs it. The balance also bounds the list (funnel.removed.balance).

buyingSignal.description: Buying signal, last 90 days. hiring: open roles from enabled signal providers. funding: a recent raise. news: company news. job_change: company hire/promote/leave news when discover finds domains; otherwise people who started a role in the last 90 days. tech: recent adopters of each of technologies[] (one tool per item; job-post evidence first, then site technology detection). any fills hiring, funding and news only (campaign any holds below score 20) — not CNPJ, CRM, visitor or person job change. cnpj discovers ATIVA companies opened in the last 90 days via the Brazilian registry and stamps the cadastral-status date when present. The campaign gate also accepts a fresh cadastral-status change. crm discovers companies with a closed-lost deal or a champion who left in the last 90 days in the connected HubSpot or Salesforce. visitor discovers companies already identified as website visitors on inbound sheets. Omit unless the user asked for a buying signal or an active campaign gate requires one. A plain people search (title + city) must not set this — company discovery runs first and can suppress normal people-search sources when it finds no companies.

cnaeCodes.description: Receita activity codes (CNAE, 4 to 7 digits) the person's company must have. Only when asked.

cnpj.description: Restrict to one Brazilian company by CNPJ. Punctuation is accepted; digits are used.

company.description: Restrict to a specific company name.

companyAgeMaxYears.description: Company opened at most this many years ago. Only when asked.

companyLocation.description: Company headquarters only when the user explicitly asked for HQ. For city/country asks such as 'em São Paulo', use location instead — an HQ-only filter turns off the sources that search by the person's city.

companyRevenueMax.description: Maximum Faturamento estimado of the person's company in BRL a year, the same estimate and rule.

companyRevenueMin.description: Minimum Faturamento estimado of the person's company in BRL a year (R$ 500 mil per month is 6000000), an estimate per CNPJ from public data, not the declared figure. The people sources have no revenue field: with no job title or an owner title the search returns the partners of companies in the range; with another title each person's company is resolved to its CNPJ after the search and checked. Rows outside the range or with the revenue unconfirmed are not delivered nor charged; the funnel counts them.

confirmed.description: true runs a search whose quote (status quote) the user accepted.

domain.description: Restrict to a company domain, e.g. acme.com.

founder.description: true: the person is a partner in the company's Receita record. Only when asked.

hiringTitle.description: Open role to discover companies hiring for, as the client says it (e.g. Head de Vendas, Gerente de Marketing); the search covers the role's family in Portuguese and English, so no exact title is needed. Distinct from jobTitle, which is the person to contact. When omitted, hiring discover is untitled (any opening).

includeNearMisses.description: true adds the near misses a previous result counted (nearMisses) after the full matches, each marked nearMiss and charged like any delivered row.

industry.description: The company's industry, e.g. "fintech". Matched against a fixed taxonomy: a value outside it is DROPPED rather than applied, and the result then carries a `warnings` entry naming the filter and suggesting valid values; such results do not match the requested industry.

jobTitle.description: Job title(s), comma-separated, e.g. "VP Sales, Head of Growth". Acronyms like "CTO" or "VP" are auto-expanded, but for broad seniority searches prefer the `seniorities` filter (c_suite, vp, director, manager, senior). Portuguese "sênior/seniores" without a specific title is experienced people — pass senior+manager, not senior alone.

languages.description: Languages the person speaks. Only when asked.

limit.description: How many people to find, 1 to 200 (default 10).

location.description: Person location, e.g. "São Paulo" or "Germany", for a city or country. Setting companyLocation to the same place as well is redundant.

niche.description: A standing audience whose companies are resolved BEFORE the people search. shopping_centers is for shopping-mall decision makers: that segment has no industry of its own, and filtering by real estate returns brokerages and proptechs instead of malls. sports_clubs is for football, basketball and multi-sport clubs, and sports_leagues for leagues, federations and confederations. location narrows it to a state or city. Not a buying signal: no time window.

page.description: One-based result page. In Deep Mode, increment this only after the prior page was returned; keep every other filter unchanged and deduplicate results.

pastCompanies.description: Companies the person worked at before. Only when asked.

peoplePerCompany.description: People per company in a list across companies, 1 to 10. Default 1, the best decision maker.

personLocation.description: Where the person is (city, state or country; SP and Brasil work). Only when asked.

roles.description: Job function keywords such as ["sales","engineering"]. Founder, co-founder, entrepreneur or owner belong in jobTitle, not here. Unknown roles disable providers that cannot filter by role.

sellsTo.description: b2b or b2c: who the company sells to, from its CNAE. Only when asked.

seniorities.description: Seniority levels, e.g. ["vp","director","c_suite"]. Bare Portuguese "seniores" is ["senior","manager"], not ["senior"] — Use senior only for senior individual contributors; it does not include managers.

shareCapitalMin.description: Minimum share capital in BRL. Only when asked.

showResults.description: Optional interactive-table presentation hint for in-product Agents.

signalPeriodDays.description: Only with buyingSignal funding: how many days back a round counts (default 90). Set it only after the user agreed to widen the period (180 or 365).

taxRegime.description: Receita size or tax regime (mei, me, epp, simples, lucro_real...). Only when asked.

technologies.description: Only with buyingSignal tech: the technologies whose adopters are discovered, e.g. ["hubspot"]. Not a people filter.

tenureMaxMonths.description: At most this many months in the current role. Only when asked.

tenureMinMonths.description: At least this many months in the current role. Only when asked.
